0022600224.text: The Utah Jazz (1-9, 1-4 at home, 0-5 on the road) host the Orlando Magic (2-7, 0-4 at home, 2-3 on the road) in the Jazz's 12th game of the 2026-27 season, with Utah on an eight-game losing streak and sitting 15th in the West and 5th in the Northwest, 7 games back. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Keyonte George (ankle sprain), and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Tristan da Silva (calf strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Jazz lost 0-2 to Orlando, most recently 120-117 in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
